pi.cmd.abortGitCommitMessage: Generate Commit Message with Pi - Stop
pi.activitybar.title: Pi
pi.config.title: Pi
pi.config.language.desc: Interface language for Pi panels and sidebars. "auto" follows the VS Code display language (falling back to English); choosing explicitly overrides it (applies to webviews and runtime messages; command titles still follow the VS Code display language). Changing this reloads open panels.
pi.config.language.enumDesc.auto: Follow the VS Code display language (falls back to English)
pi.config.path.desc: Absolute path to the pi binary. Leave empty for auto-detection.
pi.config.env.desc: Environment variables to set in the pi terminal session.
pi.config.args.desc: Extra command-line arguments passed to pi.
pi.config.commitLanguage.desc: Language for generated Git commit messages. Default is English.
pi.config.commitMessagePrompt.desc: Custom system prompt for commit message generation. If not provided, uses the default prompt.
pi.config.commitModel.desc: Model used to generate Git commit messages, in "provider/model" format (e.g. "Zai/glm-5.2").
pi.config.statusBar.desc: Show live VS Code context (active editor, selection, diagnostics) in the pi TUI footer. Disable to stop the bundled bridge from updating the footer.
pi.config.ui.enumDesc.0: Launch the pi TUI in an integrated terminal (default).
pi.config.ui.enumDesc.1: Open a webview chat panel backed by a `pi --mode rpc` subprocess.
pi.config.ui.desc: Interface for the Pi: Open command. "webview" uses a chat panel instead of a terminal.
pi.config.disabledTools.desc: LLM tools registered by bundled extensions to disable (blocklist). Defaults to none (all enabled).
pi.config.mcp.enabled.desc: Load the bundled MCP (Model Context Protocol) bridge extension, which exposes configured MCP servers' tools/resources/prompts to the agent. When disabled, no MCP servers are connected.
pi.config.mcp.idleTimeout.desc: Minutes before idle MCP servers disconnect (cached metadata keeps mcp_tool_search working). 0 disables idle disconnect. Requires restarting the pi terminal to take effect.
pi.config.permission.mode.enumDesc.0: Prompt before running bash commands that match permission.dangerousPatterns.
pi.config.permission.mode.enumDesc.1: No gating — all bash commands run without confirmation.
pi.config.permission.mode.desc: Permission mode for dangerous bash commands. AskForApproval prompts before matched commands run; FullAccess disables gating.
pi.config.permission.dangerousPatterns.d: Case-insensitive regexes marking a bash command as dangerous (requires approval in AskForApproval mode). User config fully replaces the defaults; an empty array gates nothing.
pi.config.rpcTrace.desc: Log all RPC traffic (requests, responses, events) and pi stderr to the "Pi Chat RPC" Output channel for debugging. Each webview panel is tagged by its panel id prefix.
pi.config.chatFontSize.desc: Font size for the webview chat panel. Reopen the panel to apply changes.
